item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter
item.description:
Azure announced public preview support for using service tags as inbound rules for third-party customers in network security perimeter. The feature is meant to simplify access management for network security perimeter-protected resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates
